Application Data.NAME: ABC Auto Parts Supply Co.
Application Data.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Inspection Coordinator, ABC Auto Parts Supply Co. 1234 Main Street, Anytown, CA 90210-1234, Phone: (555) 123-4567, Email: john.smith@abcautoparts.com
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ABC Auto Parts Supply Co. specializes in the retail and wholesale distribution of auto parts and accessories. Our operations include a well-lit storefront that provides a wide range of automotive components, tools, and accessories to meet customer needs. We focus on non-performance related parts and do not offer installation of high-performance aftermarket parts to mitigate risks associated with mechanical failures. Our facility is designed with clear signage to ensure customer safety, and we operate during regular business hours only, adhering to insurance guidelines. We do not engage in emergency wrecker services and do not utilize guard dogs on the premises, ensuring a safe environment for both employees and customers.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/10/2023, a minor accident occurred when a delivery vehicle backing up in the loading area struck a parked company vehicle. The cause was attributed to limited visibility due to a blind spot. The damages amounted to $1,500. The claim was processed and closed, with payment made to repair the parked vehicle. Additionally, on 09/15/2023, an employee slipped on a wet floor in the store, resulting in a minor injury. The claim costs were $500, and it is currently open, with the employee receiving treatment for a sprained ankle. Total losses reported are $2,000.00.

Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Properly lit premises with clear signage; no guard dogs; watchpersons during high traffic hours; secure storage for non-owned tools and autos.

• No 24-Hour Operations or Emergency Wrecker Services: Shops operating around the
clock or providing emergency towing are excluded due to increased risk of accidents during
off-hours and higher liability exposures.
• Limits on Non-Owned Autos and Tools: Coverage for non-owned autos and tools must
adhere to specified policy limits. For example, non-owned auto liability coverage should be
carefully reviewed to ensure it does not exceed the insured’s operational needs, mitigating
overexposure.
• Prohibition on Guard Dogs: Use of guard dogs on premises is disallowed due to potential
liability for dog bites or injuries to employees and customers.
